title: Environmental Systems Corp
story_excerpt: Founded in 1969 in Knoxville, TN, by a small group of investors, researchers from Oak Ridge National Laboratory, and University of Tennessee faculty to study thermal discharge from fossil-fired power plants into waterways. Early work included aerial infrared photography of river thermal plumes, operated out of a hangar at the Knoxville airport. Through the 1970s and 80s, ESC pioneered specialized monitoring equipment, including laser instruments for aerosol particle sizing and cooling-tower drift data collection. My role there involved building a probe for their "PILLS II-A" system — Particulate Instrumentation by Laser Light Scattering.
legacy: Later acquired by TSI Incorporated (1999), and in 2021 united with Spectrum Systems to become ESC Spectrum, specializing in air emissions compliance.
